title: Fluency is not the moat
hook_line: Google launched an insurance comparison product in March 2015 and killed it inside a year.
cliffhanger_line: Toast was founded by engineers with no restaurant background, and it beat incumbents soaked in restaurant fluency. So fluency is not the moat.
pinned_comment: If fluency isn't the moat, what is? Full breakdown linked — it's a two-question test.
why: Names three outsider failures and the Toast counterexample, then stops right before revealing what the actual moat is (accumulation), leaving the core question open.
